data.title: Rejection of application for exemption permit to drive on forest road "Am Hochries"
data.summary: Landratsamt Beispielkreis (Sachgebiet 32) rejected the application of 14 October 2025 for an exemption permit (Ausnahmegenehmigung) under Art. 13 Abs. 3 BayWaldG to drive a motor vehicle on the forest road "Am Hochries", stating that access to the property is possible via the municipal road. No fee is charged for this decision.
data.explanation: The Landratsamt has refused to let you drive on the closed forest road, saying you can reach your property via the municipal road instead. No costs were charged for this decision. If you disagree, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the same office; the app will show the exact deadline computed from the one-month period after notification. If you don't object in time, the rejection becomes final and you will not be permitted to use the forest road with a vehicle.

key_facts.label: Application date (Antrag vom)
key_facts.quote: Ihren Antrag vom 14.10.2025 auf Erteilung einer Ausnahmegenehmigung nach Art. 13 Abs. 3 BayWaldG zum Befahren des Forstwegs „Am Hochries“ mit einem Kraftfahrzeug lehnen wir ab.

key_facts.label: Fee for this decision (Kosten)
key_facts.quote: Kosten werden für diesen Bescheid nicht erhoben.
